project_type: Flutter + Riverpod local-first (SQLite) personal-finance app; UI under lib/presentation/, design system under lib/core/theme + lib/core/constants.
build_system: Flutter SDK (pubspec.yaml, environment sdk ^3.13.4). No codegen in scope. Tests use sqflite_common_ffi with databaseFactoryFfi + DatabaseHelper.setCustomDatabasePath for a temp DB.
test_framework: flutter_test (widget + unit). Existing tests in test/: widget_test.dart (smoke 'App renders without crashing' expecting find.text('MyKhata')), test/unit/transaction_filter_test.dart, transaction_calculation_test.dart, sms_parser_test.dart, sms_dedupe_test.dart, repository_invariant_test.dart, primary_account_test.dart, large_dataset_performance_test.dart, backup_export_test.dart, test/widgets/keyboard_focus_test.dart.
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: run `flutter analyze` (must be clean of new errors/warnings for touched files, including no unused-import diagnostics) and `flutter test` (all existing tests must still pass). Format touched files with `dart format <files>`; optionally `dart fix --dry-run` then `dart fix --apply` for safe in-scope fixes. Do not run device builds.
environment_constraints: Branch redesign/mykhata-2.0 is already checked out (Phase 1 = commit e317fcd). Do NOT create a worktree or new branch. Do NOT push. Commit locally, staging only the specific changed lib/ files by name — never `git add -A`; never stage .agents/ or skills-lock.json (both are untracked).
contribution_requirements: Do NOT change visual design tokens (colors, radii, shadow tiers) — that is Phase 3. Do NOT restructure bottom nav, FAB, or speed-dial. Reuse existing shared widgets; introduce no parallel component patterns. Any genuinely new shared widget goes in lib/presentation/widgets/. Keep all existing functionality working; every existing test must pass. Honor privacy masking via CurrencyFormatter.format(..., isMasked:) + privacyModeProvider where amounts are shown.
key_patterns: Theme-aware palette via context.palette (AppPalette). Text via AppText.* (display/title/body/caption/amount/overline/section). Motion via AppMotion (fast/medium/slow durations; enter/emphasized curves). Haptics via AppHaptics (tap/select/success/warning). Money via CurrencyFormatter.format(value, isMasked:). Shared widgets: AppCard(+CardElevation), Pressable, FadeSlideIn, SegmentedTabs, PillChips/PillChip, AppDropdown<T>, MultiSelectField, PrimaryButton, AppBottomSheet.show + showFieldsSheet(FieldSpec), EmptyState, SettingsGroup/ListRowTile, AsyncSection<T>. Navigation via AppRoutes.push / AppRoutes.pushModal (pushModal is a generic that can return a value). Transaction filtering: transactionListProvider (StateNotifier) exposes setFilter / updateFilter((f)=>f.copyWith(...)) / clearFilters / setSearchQuery; TransactionFilter.copyWith supports type, datePeriod (+clearType/clearDatePeriod/clearCustomDateRange), categoryIds, etc. DateFilters string presets include exact 'This Month','Last Month','Today','This Week'. TransactionModel.copyWith uses `field ?? this.field` so it CANNOT set a nullable field (e.g. categoryId) back to null. SMS card bank->account match lives in _SmsCardState._match in sms_review_screen.dart. In-repo collapsible precedent: _SmsCardState._showOriginal uses AnimatedSize(AppMotion.fast, AppMotion.enter) + GestureDetector header.
directory_structure: lib/core/{theme,constants,navigation,utils,database,logging}; lib/data/{models,repositories}; lib/services/{sms,location,receipts,backup,export,import}; lib/presentation/{screens/<feature>,providers,widgets}; test/{unit,widgets,widget_test.dart}. .agents/tasks/mykhata-phase2-ux holds this plan + FEAT artifacts (never committed).
